issues.priority: qualification certificate must be supplemented before scientific admission
issues.title: The pass receipt is broader than the executed assertions
issues.finding: The CLI asserts eval identity logits/common-body and boundary-weight gradients, one-or-more nonzero gradient tensors, finite train/validation loss, and selected checkpoint replay. It does not assert all-node finite logits/gradients, member-wise connectivity, expected optimizer membership/rates, copied private biases, dormant-owner exclusion, or equality of restored local Adam tensors and step counters. The qualification receipt nonetheless writes passed=True and calls its scope finite training and stage restoration.
issues.action: Retain this as partial qualification evidence. Add explicit checks and recorded evidence for every declared gate, including full logits and active per-stage parameters, and verify transition model/Adam state against the selected local checkpoint before the first global step.

issues.title: Qualification receipts are not bound to the qualified graph or label-independent input identity
issues.finding: The fit gate compares backbone, family, environment and implementation hashes only; the receipt records no graph_input, preprocessing identity or role descriptor. Same-dimensional alternative graphs can satisfy prepare_graph and yield a reusable pass receipt. Exact provider/row identity and full-graph resource behavior therefore remain external prerequisites, as QUALIFICATION.md states.
issues.action: Bind the receipt to verified graph_input and preprocessing identity, source seal and full graph dimensions, then require equality before teacher labels are opened. Record separate full-schedule feasibility approval or evidence instead of deriving it from the short qualification.

issues.title: Per-cell correction report bypasses six-freeze closure
issues.finding: The control report requires all six correction score freezes, but the correction driver report checks only its own SCORE_FREEZE and opens its compact pool labels. After one correction finishes, its final labels can be reported while the other five corrections remain selectable. This requires no altered immutable input and violates the stated shared delayed label gate.
issues.action: Use one verified study-level final-label release certificate that proves the six selected primary GNNM correction score freezes and their exact roles/admissions. Require it in every final-label reader, including the copied per-cell correction report, before reading a label pack.

issues.title: Successful-cell selection does not enforce the no-favorable-retry rule
issues.finding: Output directories are exclusive but arbitrary, and admissions do not bind a preregistered output/attempt identity. Selection accepts twelve successful cells with unique config/seed keys. Failed attempts from other folders are neither enumerated nor charged by the selection artifact. A failed cell can be rerun to a fresh folder and only the successful attempt submitted, satisfying current source checks.
issues.action: Freeze the 72 cell/admission/output identities before scientific launch. Keep an append-only attempt ledger, match every selection to the registered terminal attempt, retain and charge all failures, and require any allowed source repair/retry to use a separately versioned declared protocol.

issues.title: Role pairing does not establish identical train/validation label bytes across controls
issues.finding: Config and cross-family pairing compare exact role_freeze descriptors, which establish node identities. Each fit can nevertheless receive a different train/validation label pack for those same nodes; load_source accepts any in-range labels and selection never compares the source_labels descriptors in cell admissions. A packing/row-label extraction error affecting one family could be silently treated as a fair paired experiment.
issues.action: Freeze one independently extracted train and validation label descriptor pair per graph/seed and verified provider/row map. Verify those immutable packs and require their hashes to match for every config and family, with extraction provenance bound to the study.
